name: FlexiGuard 510(k)
description: A traditional 510(k) premarket notification to the US FDA for the FlexiGuard FG-200 wound dressing (silicone contact layer and polyurethane foam).
notice: Example files loaded. The clinical, risk and labeling files are fictional; the CFR and FDA texts are real public documents.

demo.find: The label includes warnings and instructions for use.
demo.text: Because the 510(k) has been submitted, our brochure will call the FlexiGuard FG-200 an FDA approved dressing.
demo.say: Add a sentence that calls the device FDA approved.
demo.expect: The rule against official-approval claims (21 CFR 807.97) turns red with a warning.

demo.find: Because the 510(k) has been submitted, our brochure will call the FlexiGuard FG-200 an FDA approved dressing.
demo.text: Once FDA finds the device substantially equivalent, our brochure will describe it as 510(k) cleared, never as FDA approved.
demo.say: Rewrite it the correct way: 510(k) cleared, never FDA approved.

demo.find: Testing per ISO 10993-1 included cytotoxicity and sensitization.
demo.text: Testing on the final finished, ethylene oxide sterilized device covered cytotoxicity (ISO 10993-5), sensitization (ISO 10993-10) and intracutaneous reactivity (ISO 10993-23). Acute systemic toxicity, material-mediated pyrogenicity, subacute toxicity and genotoxicity were addressed by chemical characterization with a toxicological risk assessment.
demo.say: Fill the biocompatibility gap: name every endpoint from the ISO summary.
demo.expect: Biocompatibility rules (the ISO 10993 endpoints, testing on the final finished device) appear or go from amber to green.

demo.say: Change a number so it no longer matches the clinical study report (it reports 2 device-related events).
demo.expect: Several rules turn red with a warning, among them the clinical and performance test rules: the page now contradicts the clinical study report.

demo.find:
Substantial equivalence
The predicate device is K123456.
demo.say: Delete the whole substantial equivalence paragraph.
demo.expect: The predicate rules leave the list: the page is no longer about them, so they go neutral.

demo.text:
Sterility and shelf life
The dressing is sterilized with ethylene oxide to a sterility assurance level of 10^-6. The shelf life is 3 years from the date of manufacture, and the use-by date is printed on each pouch and carton.
demo.say: Paste a new paragraph about sterility and shelf life.
demo.expect: New rules about sterility and shelf life appear. Sterility is green; shelf life can show red until the test method is named.

demo.find: printed on each pouch and carton.
demo.text: The shelf life is supported by accelerated aging per ASTM F1980 followed by package integrity and seal strength testing, with real-time aging studies ongoing.
demo.say: Add how the shelf life was tested.
demo.expect: The shelf-life method rule turns green.
